principle: Shared islands are excluded from the fresh 5592-island target population before partition/model freezing. Numeric ID equality is diagnostic only because the two sources do not share a frozen identifier namespace.

automatic_conservative_exclusions.exact_normalized_historical_name_match: exclude every fresh routing ID matching any exact normalized historical Island name through Weigelt island/gazetteer/name_alt identity surfaces; ambiguous multiple matches are all excluded
automatic_conservative_exclusions.missing_fresh_identity_name: exclude every fresh routing ID with no nonblank island, gazetteer or name_alt field

name_normalization.punctuation: replace non-alphanumeric runs with one space

manual_geographic_adjudication.required_for: every historical island lacking an automatic exact-name match
manual_geographic_adjudication.evidence_rule: must cite response-independent island identity/geography; biological occurrence information is forbidden

pass_rule: all 318 historical identities are either covered by irreversible automatic exclusions or resolved by completed response-independent geographic adjudication; all named additional target IDs are excluded; all unnamed fresh target identities remain excluded
hold_rule: without complete adjudication, emit candidate matches and a template but do not emit a final eligible target list and do not authorize response opening
